live.auth: OpenF1 only serves live data to accounts with a subscription. Set OPENF1_USERNAME and OPENF1_PASSWORD in your environment to enable it (see the README).
live.idle_hint: Live positions and track flags appear here automatically during practice, qualifying and the race.
live.login: OpenF1 rejected the username and password in OPENF1_USERNAME and OPENF1_PASSWORD.
live.rate: The live feed is rate limited; it will retry shortly.
live.token: OpenF1 refused the access token. A new one is requested automatically.
live.unavailable: A session is running, but live timing is not available.

animations.description: Fade in the circuit and run the start lights when the Schedule tab opens on race day.
animations.label: Animated intro

countdown_target.description: What the pill in the bar counts down to.
countdown_target.label: Bar countdown target

debug_force_tabs.description: Shows the Grid and Live tabs outside a race weekend, using the data of the last session. Turn it off for normal use.
debug_force_tabs.label: Debug: force Grid and Live tabs

default_tab.description: The tab the panel opens on. The live timing and the starting grid take over automatically when they apply.
default_tab.label: Default tab

favorite_driver.description: Three-letter driver code, for example VER. Shown in the accent colour in every table.
favorite_driver.label: Highlight driver

favorite_team.description: Team id as the data source writes it, for example ferrari or red_bull.
favorite_team.label: Highlight team

notify_lead_min.description: Minutes before the race start, 0 to 120.
notify_lead_min.label: Notification lead time

notify_race.description: Send one desktop notification shortly before lights out.
notify_race.label: Notify before the race

team_colors.description: A coloured chip beside each driver and team.
team_colors.label: Show team colors

time_format.description: How session times are written in the panel and the tooltip.
time_format.label: Time format
